sentences.text: It is submitted by the counsel for the petitioner that initially, Crime No.50/2022 has been registered by the husband of the petitioner at Police Station Hastinapur, District Gwalior for offence under Section 363, 354, 376 of IPC.

The FIR was with regard to her daughter being missing as someone had kidnapped her, but after her recovery as in her 161 & 164 of CrPC statement, she had stated that her own father had committed rape on her, the husband of the petitioner was arrested.
But when her husband moved an application seeking bail, before the Hon'ble High Court, it transpired that the girl was swayed by someone to implicate her own father.
Considering the said statement, bail was granted to the husband of the petitioner and since the petitioner was kept in One Stop Center.
The petitioner, who is the mother of the juvenile/prosecutrix, has filed a representation before the trial Court for custody of her daughter but the said representation has been dismissed.

Thereafter, the petitioner had again filed an representation dated 08/12/2022 (Annexure P/1) before respondent No.2 for providing the custody of her daughter but till date, no action has been taken on the said representation.

A limited prayer has been made by the counsel for the petitioner that in case,
directions are issued to the respondents/authorities to consider the said representation and pass a reasoned order, his grievance would be redressed.
Per contra, the petition is not opposed by the counsel for the State.

Looking to the innocuous prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondent no.3-Chairman, Child Welfare Committee, Gwalior to decide the said representations within a period of two weeks in accordance with law from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
With the aforesaid direction, petition is disposed off.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on merits of the case.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE Monika MONIKA SHARMA 2023.01.20 17:30:33 +05'30'
